description: This donut chart, titled “Stimuli Type,” visually represents the distribution of different types of stimuli used in a study, likely related to generative AI’s application in journalism as indicated by the paper’s title and the caption “Agency A.” The chart is divided into eight distinct colored segments, each labeled with its category and corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents “Draft/Other” at 28.5%. Following this, “Press Release” is shown in a golden-yellow hue at 21.9%. The “External News Article” segment, colored dark green, accounts for 13.1%. “Interview,” in a dark navy blue, makes up 10.2%. “Organizational Report” and “Event Posting,” both in shades of purple, are tied at 8.8%. “Organizational Website,” in a light blue, represents 6.6%. “Social Media Post,” in a very light green, constitutes 1.5%. The smallest segment, “Intra-agency news article,” in a pale orange, is at 0.7%. Each category’s label and percentage are clearly displayed adjacent to its respective slice, and the chart includes a central white circle with the title “Stimuli Type.” The segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top right and proceeding clockwise.
